title: Utho Aye Sakina Utho
body:
Utho ay Sakina s.a.... sunsaan hain zindaa'n.
Jee paayegi kaise..... tanha yeh teri maa.
1. Wehshat hai barasti har soo hain andhera**2.
Is qaid mein kaise.....so paayegi naada'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek baar mujhe phir maa kehke pukaaro..*2
Is tarha na mujhko..... tadpao meri jaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ab humko mili hain zindaa'n se rihaayi..*2
Jaane ka watan ko..... kab se tha yeh armaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Yun chod ke mujh ko jaati ho jo bibi..*2
Madar ka tumhari...... hain maut ka saama'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Karbal se lahad tak ruqsaar hain soojhe..*2
Jo zulm kiye tum par..... the kaise musalmaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aankho'n mein wo manzar mehfooz hain bibi..*2
Tar qoo'n se tha tera... masoom sa daama'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Rulwaate hai bibi ab tak bhi tera ghum..*2
Uth-ta hai har ek aankh se..... ab ashkon ka toofaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Mehshar tha sohail ek zindaan e sitam mein..*2
Yeh roke fighaa'n karti thi.... jab kook jali maa.
Kalaam: janab Raza Ali sohail sahab.
